fusions.name: Sentence Carried Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Brings the edge down for 24 damage, using up every affliction on the target and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Guillotine Cut
fusions.desc: Drops a trimming blade through a narrow cone 4 tiles long, dealing 15 damage to every enemy in it and stunning each for 1 second. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Headsman's Commission
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: The Condemned Roll
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
